description: Lucrezia velvet — Colore: Sabbia & gold Collezione: Lucis Codice: 2L04121 Materiale: 9% Cashmere, 91% Cotton Disegno: Damask Scala: Large Altezza: 136 cm Rapporto: 45.3 cm × 72 cm Toni: Yellow LUCREZIA is one of Fortuny's most classic patterns printed on velvet — a 17th-century Italian design that pays tribute to ‘Lucretia,’ the ancient Roman noblewoman immortalized by Rembrandt in 1664. In large plumes and intricate tendrils, the motifs unfold across a densely decorated field: symmetrical, balanced, and rich with the formal authority of baroque decorative tradition. The large-scale repeat makes LUCREZIA a natural choice for expansive wall applications and generous drapery where the full composition can be read. On upholstery, the scale commands attention — although it is suited well to both statement pieces and s upporting roles. Finished with Fortuny's metallic pigments on a cashmere-cotton ground, LUCREZIA brings quiet luxury and timeless decorative presence to refined interiors.
